query: Design a media player UI that has to work on a phone, a laptop, and a TV.
expected_behavior: Designs for input, not just width: touch with large targets and gestures on the phone, hover and precision on the laptop, explicit focus navigation for the TV remote
Never makes essential actions hover-only, since the same design meets touch and remote
Uses fluid type (clamp) and content-driven breakpoints rather than fixed device widths
Addresses the 10-foot canvas specifics: larger type and spacing, a strong visible focus treatment, and overscan-safe margins
Respects safe areas and touch target minimums (at least 44px)
